hypothesis: VCP follow-through depends on the stock's advance lifecycle: a base formed after a meaningful prior advance should differ from repeated distinct bases late in the same one-year trend episode.
deduplication: Keep the earliest signal for each symbol, scale, and pivot_date; later daily signals from the same detected base are not independent setups.
analysis: overall pairwise ranking probability for binary follow-through
within-year fixed quintile profiles for continuous features
decision_rule: Treat the lifecycle mechanism as supported only if at least one causal feature has the hypothesized direction overall, the same direction in at least 7 of 10 calendar years with usable positive and negative labels, and a broadly ordered quintile profile. Otherwise stop this direction. No cutoff, score, strategy filter, or portfolio backtest may be created from this audit.
anti_overfit: No parameter search, threshold selection, feature combination, model fitting, or selection by portfolio return. All listed features and summaries are reported, including null or contrary results.
causal_limit: The three candidate files are exposed development datasets and use future paths only for outcome labels. This audit can select a research direction, not validate alpha or live eligibility.
